run_conformal_training_experiment: run a conformal training experiment on cifar10 with multiple random seeds using the CLI
get_parameters_for_dataset: get the configuration and hyperparameter sweep for a given dataset and experiment name
run_parameter_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep across multiple values for a single config key across seeds
run_experiment_with_debug: run an experiment in debug mode to skip actual training and only log configuration
update_config_value: update a config value using a dot-separated key path like seed or path
